about: Modwerk source-only kit-ab package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/kit-ab.

mods.title: Kit A/B
mods.summary: NO + PLAY MODE becomes an A/B between the kit as edited and as saved.
mods.description: Kit A/B changes the single-kit reload. The first NO + PLAY MODE (or RELOAD in the KIT menu) keeps your edits in a stash and loads the saved kit, with stock's popup KIT 1 RELOADED!. The next press puts the edits back and shows EDITS RESTORED!. Editing while the original plays ends the A/B: the next press keeps those edits instead, drops the stashed ones and reloads as a first press does. The same happens after a change of kit or any other reload. A press on a kit with no edits is a plain reload and arms nothing. Reloading every kit stays stock. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0010-kit-ab, with his code unchanged.
mods.author: Iced-Cream
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported by the author: in build KBH7 (Modwerk's base, core-ar2 0.7, with analoghealth 1.2 for remote keys), the KIT menu's RELOAD stashed a BD DEC edit (KIT RELOADED!) and restored it (EDITS RESTORED!), and an edit while the saved kit played, or a change of kit, ended the A/B. NO + PLAY MODE has not been run on the unit yet. This package's own bytes have not been flashed from the site.
